Base Criterion for Problem-solving: A problem that continously repeats.

This is known as the fundamnetal base class of all non-trivail, non-critical problems (worth attending to): a cyclic-problem. This is the fundamental class of problem; it's components include: Time (T), Pattern (P)

Why is this the fundamental Criterion in Problem-Solving? This is where we approach the Axiom from a different angle; reconstructive processing.
